deals.title: You are welcome and free to play, pray, dance, witness, surrender, relax, and experience yourself and others as divine.
deals.description: Welcome to Vienna Temple Nights, a series of magical and unique experiences, based on ancient traditions of gathering in sacred space to celebrate and worship love, the heart space, our humanity, aliveness, one another and our connection to the Divine. It is where we unite, within and without. EVERYTHING IS WELCOME, NOTHING HAS TO HAPPEN. These Temple Nights are a healthy dose of human connection, to explore connective practices that will open your heart, explore deeper intimacy with yourself or a partner, enjoy the sensation and aliveness of your body, learn practices for setting healthy boundaries, come home to your heart, laugh, play and share a moment of authenticity with others. THE FLOW: 12-18 o’clock - Introduction into Temples We’ll begin with beautifully guided experiences and practices created to support the exploration of our individual energies and heart-based, playful, energetic, physical connections with one another. You will receive practical knowledges around setting healthy boundaries and consent and will profoundly explore them in many ways. By 18 o’clock you will be able to skilfully express your own authentic desires and boundaries and develop deep, authentic, respectful connections with others. ✨ You are welcome to continue with us for the Advanced part of the evening - the Love Temple ✨ 19.30-24 o’clock - Love Temple This Temple is for people who already have experience in $ex-positive spaces, tantra, intimacy, and sacred $exuality work. The Temple will be held and facilitated with the intention to bring up our Divine nature, Innocence and Sensuality. You will be guided through solo, group and partnered practices of conscious connection, embodiment, play, authentic communication and present, loving touch. As the journey unfolds the Temple will transform into an open playground for those who wish to continue their explorations at their own pace and flow. You are welcome and free to play, pray, dance, witness, surrender, relax, and experience yourself and others as divine. Questions: olgahomsi@yahoo.com #templenight#viennaevents#1000thingstodoinvienna #vienna #austria
